tqv._comment: Primary source: VR Systems 'Turnout Quick View' per-county static feeds on S3. index.json lists a county's election ids; the right one has Summary.FvrsElectionNumber == fvrs_election_number.

not_on_tqv.BRO: Broward switched vendors away from VR Systems; its last TQV election is the March 11, 2025 municipal

broward_enr._comment: Registered voters for Broward (no TQV): from its election-results system's summary XML. Prefers the 2026 General, else the latest countywide election (registration is stable across a cycle).

dos._comment: Secondary source: FL Dept of State statewide consolidated file. Provides 'mail ballots outstanding' (not in TQV) and serves as a fallback if a county's TQV feed is unavailable.

races.note: 2026 U.S. Senate special election for the seat vacated by Marco Rubio; on the Nov 3 general ballot (election #49894).

broward_ted._comment: Broward left VR Systems (TQV) and reports vote-by-mail on its own TED ElectionLink dashboard. fl_update reads the 'By Party' tiles (issued / returned) from the dashboard's html endpoint; used for Broward's mail figures whenever it reports at least as many returned ballots as the DOS file.
